waitForTurn: wait for the answer, or cancel it first
help: keys:
enter                 send the line
ctrl+enter, ctrl+j, trailing \   new line instead of sending
tab                   complete the selected command
ctrl+a, ctrl+e, left, right   move the caret
ctrl+left, ctrl+right  move a word at a time
backspace, delete      delete a character, or a word with ctrl
up, down              walk the command hints, or the prompts of this scope
page up, page down    scroll the conversation
esc                   cancel the turn in flight
ctrl+c                copy what is picked out
ctrl+v                type what was copied last
ctrl+d                leave
commands:
/create <description> make an npc and talk to it
/enter <id>           talk to another npc
/npcs                 list the npcs
/leave                leave the conversation
/clear                drop the active conversation, keep the persona
/raw [on|off]         show every turn as the JSON the model wrote
/help                 this list
/quit                 leave
noSuchNpc: no such npc   /npcs to list them
noNpcs: no npcs yet   /create to make one
noNpc: no npc   /create to make one, /enter to pick one
cancelled: (cancelled: the turn was stopped before it was whole)
statusHintLobby: no npc   /create to make one   /help for keys
